description: IPC access for the Macro Deck UI in development: tauri dev treats the devUrl (http://localhost:4200) as a local context, so local access plus these permissions cover the dev loop. Packaged builds load the UI from a runtime-assigned loopback origin instead; the equivalent grant is registered at runtime in window.rs (CapabilityBuilder) because the port is only known after the bootstrapper assigned it. The app commands themselves are declared in build.rs (app_manifest).
